entry.title: Building a Minigame Ep 2 - Planet Wheat

media:group.media:title: Building a Minigame Ep 2 - Planet Wheat
media:group.media:description:
I was hit by a near fatal dose of the notorious man flu yesterday, which kept me unable to speak and move for a big part of the day. But at 18:00 i decided enough is enough and i need to get my legs going. but as soon as i climbed down the stairs the sickness hit me again and i was stuck in the computer room. "Oh shit", i thought and decided the best thing i could do was calm my nerves while playing games and watching videos and i spent the rest of the day buildin on the minigame. But thankfully I survived the whole deal and lived to tell the tale, and today im healthy as a horse!
Just some building on the "restroom" area for the 2 player arena on the easy difficulty mode. Also some archival footage that never made it up on youtube before. Next video should be more progress on the 2 player arena.
Music: Ted Irens - Two Mountains Respect that dude, he has some nice music and deserves more attention than he has, so check him out!

entry.title: Let's Build a Minigame #1 - Introduction to Hoppin' Rabbits

media:group.media:title: Let's Build a Minigame #1 - Introduction to Hoppin' Rabbits
media:group.media:description:
Welcome to a new series! its of a minigame ive been working on for a long time called "hoppin rabbits". The goal is to shoot rabbits and get 23 meat that you throw in a chest that stops the timer. The game can be played solo or up to 4 people, with 3 different difficulties and 12 different maps it should turn out to be pretty damn fantastic, if i do everything right. This first video is an introduction where i explain how it works and is therefor pretty boring, but the next vids should be more entertaining with music and timelapses and all that. also if anyone watching has any ideas on what to build, comment! and ill take it into consideration at least
Music: Intro: I think i made it, i found it in a old folder with shitty music i made but that doesnt mean its mine. if i did not make it, sorry :I
Outro: I made that song atleast and it can be found here:

media:group.media:title: Minecraft - Slimeblock Minecart Junction - Tutorial
media:group.media:description:
I wanted a cool way to make a subway system in my world but the old standard junctions has been built so many times so i wanted something new. So what i did is i made something out of slimeblocks and the way that you choose direction is by pushing blocks in the minecarts path through the air, so it falls down on the track and goes on its way.

entry.title: Minecraft - Doks LP E:2 :: Wither Skele Farm & Gold Farm

media:group.media:title: Minecraft - Doks LP E:2 :: Wither Skele Farm & Gold Farm
media:group.media:description:
Click read more for shortcuts
im back! i'm in the middle of a huge inspiration boost right now where i just have to play some minecraft. This time i did the most i could out of it and made a video. A very laidback ep this time guys. We go over some of the stuff i've done, and i talk a bit about where I've been and where i'm going. We check out the wither skeleton pad/farm changes madeto get some more wither skellys/wither skulls. We also check out a gold farm built at the quarry base, the new layout for the iron farm collection area, a new bridge build at spawn and some more. But again, a relaxed kinda lp today so sit back, relax and enjoy the show.
